display.purpose: Page H1 and the year-ring's centered day-count only.

body.purpose: Everything else — one family, every role, via weight.

shadows.name: surface-float
shadows.purpose: The one diffuse shadow every floating card/panel/nav gets.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Small elements: board image cards, remove button.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.value: transform 150ms ease; hover 1.02-1.03 scale, active 0.98 scale

motion.name: tap-hint
motion.purpose: Category badge's click-cursor icon, signals it's interactive.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill button, coral fill, used for '+ Add Image', 'Analyze Board', 'Get Next Steps'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #cd3213; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; border: none; transition: transform 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #95240e; transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #f4f5f8; color: #616875; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Category Badge
components.description: Tonal pill: pastel category tint background, saturated category text. The only badge style in the system.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Dashboard Card
components.description: The board canvas and next-steps rail: white rounded card floating on the light canvas.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 28px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -28px rgba(15,23,42,0.35); } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #14171f; }

components.name: Year Progress Ring
components.description: Radial SVG progress ring (fraction of year elapsed) with the day-count centered — the system's one signature device, translated from the reference's BPM gauge.
components.html: 131
components.css: .ds-ring { position: relative; width: 128px; height: 128px; } .ds-ring-value { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.875rem; color: #14171f; }

components.name: Nav / Segmented Filter
components.description: White pill container; active segment is a solid fill (coral for global nav, category color for filters) — the one place solid category color still appears.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -20px rgba(15,23,42,0.4); } .ds-segment-active { background: #cd3213; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-segment { color: #616875; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; }

narrative.overview: Vision Board's second visual world trades the first world's draft-day broadcast intensity for a calm, modern health/fitness-dashboard register — the vocabulary of a heart-rate or step-tracking app checked first thing in the morning. White rounded cards float on a light neutral canvas; one coral-red accent carries every primary action and the year's radial progress ring; five pastel category badges do the work saturated jersey-tag chips did in the first world, just quieter. This is a genuine redesign: the user re-pinned with new references after living with the sports-broadcast world, and this system replaces it outright — the old world is evidence of a direction tried and moved past, not an alternate authority.
keyCharacteristics: Light neutral canvas with white cards, 24-28px radius, soft diffuse shadows — no dark panels anywhere in this world
One coral-red brand accent for every primary action and the progress ring; never a rainbow of equally-loud CTAs
Five tonal category badges (pastel background + saturated text); solid fills reserved for the segmented filter control only
A single geometric sans (Plus Jakarta Sans) carries every role from big numerals to small labels via weight alone
A radial progress ring is the one signature device, reserved for the year-countdown

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Coral is the only color that appears as a solid, attention-seeking fill outside the fixed category taxonomy.

rules.name: The No Second Face Rule
rules.body: Every piece of type is Plus Jakarta Sans at some weight; no second family without a product reason.

rules.name: The Diffuse-Only Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is large-blur/low-opacity; no tight, dark, or hard-edged shadow anywhere.

dos: Do keep coral as the only solid loud accent outside the category taxonomy.
Do render every category badge as pastel-background/saturated-text.
Do use Plus Jakarta Sans at whatever weight the moment needs; never a second family.
Do give every floating card the same one-shadow diffuse treatment.
donts: Don't reintroduce the first world's dark panels, saturated field, or condensed display face.
Don't style an unwired feature to look active; mute it like Sign In.
Don't drop text below 0.75rem (12px) anywhere in the system.
